title: Step Base
description: Shared base properties for all pipeline step schemas. Does not set additionalProperties — intended as a composable fragment.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI identifying the schema this artifact conforms to. Must match the schema registered for this pipeline step in schema_registry.json.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this artifact instance (e.g., 'charter-v1', 'fr-list-v1').

owner.description: Owner of this spec artifact. Must be a valid owner from the canonical registry (canon/kinds/owner.json).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this artifact was generated or last regenerated.

canonical_refs_used.description: Array of canonical registry references used in this artifact. Validated by canonical-integrity checks.

canonical_proposals.description: Array of proposed new canonical terms discovered during generation. Empty array if none proposed.

canonical_conflicts.description: Array of canonical resolution conflicts encountered during generation. Empty array if none.

_migration_notes.description: Optional migration annotations added by canonical-autofix or align tooling.
